title: Kleinian hyperelliptic funtions of weight 2 associated with curves of genus 2
summary: We introduce a new collection of special functions associated to a complex curve of genus 2 similar to Kleinian hyperelliptic $σ$-function. These functions are related to weight 2 $θ$-functions in the same fashion as $σ$-function is related to the classical $θ$-function. A key feature of the introduced functions is the fact that they are well-defined for genus 2 algebraic curves without any restrictions (in particular it is not needed to assume that the curve has a Weierstrass point at infinity).
